revisions.text: - A live test of a worktree's code runs it by explicit path (`.worktrees/<name>/bin/<tool>`) or an environment override, never by repointing a shared launcher, symlink, service unit, or config include on the host at the worktree. When a host pointer must be repointed, record it in a task note at that moment (what, from, to, how to restore) and restore it before `tasks park` or `tasks done`; while it stands, the park note names it. Before removing a worktree, check that no host pointer resolves into it (`readlink -f` over `~/bin/*`, `~/.local/bin/*`, user systemd units, known config includes) and refuse while one does. A rollout that hands live state to another project's tool checks where that tool resolves on `PATH` first, rather than assuming the main checkout.
